claim.text: The source says cart abandonment cannot be reduced to zero because 43% of abandoners were just browsing and were never going to buy that day; focus on the remaining fixable reasons.
claim.quote: 43% of those people were just browsing and were never going to buy today. So, you'll never get it to zero. But for the rest, they left for a reason that we can try to fix.
